没有应用的当前版本在用它。: No current app version uses it.

没有连线和变量引用受影响。: No connections or variable references are affected.

没配资产仓库，暂时不能把资产提交到资产仓库。: No assets repository is configured, so assets can't be submitted yet.

流程在同一步来回的次数到了上限: The flow looped on the same step too many times

流程走的总步数到了上限: The flow reached its step limit
